_doc: Scale versus count: the two directions the detector can get wrong.
A 0-4 count of children and a 0-4 five-point item have identical value
distributions, so values alone cannot separate them. This fixture holds
both directions so each change has to state what it moved.
`expected` is current behaviour. The scale rows still marked `numeric` are
the zero-based ones: the detector deliberately does not guess at them, and
surfaces a scale_candidate hint instead (see is_scale_candidate).
Data is generated deterministically from (low, high, seed); 300 rows.
The `ambiguous` group is the point of the whole exercise: those columns are
undecidable from values alone. No detector setting can resolve them.
